newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait MPs to grill finance minister mid-July.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait MPs to grill finance minister mid-July.

text.p: Kuwait's parliament on Tuesday decided to call to account Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan on July 15 over alleged irregularities in key economic bodies.
Rodhan told parliament he was ready to answer all questions.
"I will answer all that came in the interpellation. I stress that I have always been and will always be keen on safeguarding public funds," Rodhan said.
Parliament speaker Ahmad al-Saadoun set July 15 the date for the questioning, the first since the election of parliament in October 1996.
"I was indeed surprised by the contents of the interpellation," said Rodhan who has been accused of intentionally wasting public funds and laxity in implementing the law.
Three opposition MPs on Saturday presented the house with a request to question Rodhan.
Rodhan chairs the Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA), which manages the state's foreign investments of about $40 billion, the Central Bank and Kuwait Airways.
Acting Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad has expressed confidence in Rodhan after the three MPs said they planned to present the request.

A parliamentary source has said Rodhan would be asked about suspected lack of action on alleged violations by some of the institutions he oversees. He noted that Rodhan was not suspected of involvement in "wrongdoings of criminal nature."
